title: RBI MPC raises benchmark repo rate by 50 bps to 4.90% to combat persistent inflation
summary: The Monetary Policy Committee unanimously voted to hike policy repo rate by 50 basis points, citing geopolitical price pressures and anchoring long-term inflation expectations.

title: Government 10-year bond yield spikes to 7.53% following RBI hawkish policy commentary
summary: Benchmark sovereign bond yields rose to their highest level in three years as debt markets priced in aggressive central bank liquidity withdrawal.

title: Nifty Realty index plunges 2.5% as home loan EMI burden threatens housing demand
summary: Real estate developers saw sharp selloffs led by DLF and Godrej Properties as commercial banks raised retail mortgage rates in response to the repo rate hike.

title: Bank Nifty faces volatile session as cost of deposits catches up with lending yields
summary: Major private and PSU banks experienced margin compression concerns and treasury MTM markdowns on sovereign bond holdings despite widening loan spreads.

title: TCS and IT exporters gain as rupee depreciation provides valuation buffer
summary: Indian IT exporters benefited from USD foreign currency billing realization as interest rate differentials weighed on emerging market currencies.
